restaurant.name: 2616 Cafe
restaurant.welcome: Good food, great vibes, right after class.
restaurant.description: 2616 Cafe is the go-to hangout for school and college students: cheesy pizzas, juicy burgers and crispy combos at pocket-friendly prices. Scan the 2616 menu card to see every dish on your table in 3D before you order.

items.name: Veggie Cheese Pizza
items.tagline: Loaded with mozzarella and fresh veggies
items.description: Our 8-inch hand-tossed pizza, baked until the cheese bubbles and the crust turns golden. Topped with crunchy bell peppers, onion and sweet corn. Perfect to share between classes.

items.name: Classic Chicken Burger
items.tagline: Juicy grilled chicken in a toasted sesame bun
items.description: A thick, juicy grilled chicken patty layered with melted cheese, crisp lettuce, tomato and our signature burger mayo, all inside a soft toasted sesame bun.
items.preparationStyle: Flame-grilled patty on a toasted bun

items.name: Peri Peri Fries Combo
items.tagline: Crispy fries, a chilled drink and a ketchup dip
items.description: Golden, crispy fries tossed in our zesty peri peri seasoning, served with a tangy ketchup dip and a chilled soft drink. The ultimate study-break combo.
